title: The robot shoulder printed in place: one print, nothing to assemble but the motor
summary: The bench shoulder's compound planetary drawn to come off the bed in one piece: every gap the printer's print gap, herringbone teeth, no carrier, checked by Manifold for gaps and by the slicer's eye for supports. Side by side with the assembled 38:1, with the play each is predicted to have. Predictions only so far: nothing has been printed
